notes: Delivery location: new field 'Delivery location link' (Google Maps → Share → Copy link, or latitude, longitude) in Buyer B2B, Buyer B2C and each delivery address (godown). When the invoice is printed both-sided, the back page has the e-way bill made smaller and below it a Delivery Location box with the QR code on the right and a note for the driver in English and Hindi. The box is printed even when there is no e-way bill. Buyer B2C now also has Payment by (1–45 days) and Send payment reminder YES / NO; B2C customers get automatic payment reminders like B2B buyers.
